<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" initial="p">
  <parallel id="p">
    <state id="download" initial="fetching">
      <state id="fetching"><transition event="fetched" target="saved"/></state>
      <state id="saved"/>
    </state>
    <state id="spinner"/>
  </parallel>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: state `saved` has no outgoing transition and may never exit

primary.message: non-final atomic state has no exit

notes: neither this state nor any enclosing `<state>` or `<parallel>` has a transition or `<invoke>`, and no transition in an enclosing `<parallel>` can leave that `<parallel>`, so once entered the machine can never leave it
diagnostics.help: add an outgoing transition, make this a `final` state, or document an intentional externally terminated wait
